t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion of 2014, a temporary building that has since been taken down. It was designed by the Chilean architect Smiljan Radic. The pavilions are short-lived by nature, built for a single summer season, so what you see now is the place where it stood rather than the structure itself. Radic is the person to remember here, as the architect whose design occupied this spot for that year.
